brief.goal: a printed 70x70x30mm trinket box with 2mm walls and a separate 70x70x5mm lift-off lid held shut by eight 6x3mm neodymium disc magnets, four pressed into pockets in the box's corners and four in the lid's corners facing them
brief.design: A clean, small keepsake object: soft 1 mm fillets on all outside edges and corners so the box and lid read as one smooth block when closed, crisp unchamfered faces where lid meets rim so the seam is tight. Plain surfaces with no decoration; the magnets stay hidden inside the corners.

box.title: Trinket box
box.spec: Open-topped square trinket box printed in one piece, 70x70x30 mm with 2 mm walls and floor. Each of the four inside corners carries a solid square corner post that runs from the floor up to the rim, so a 6x3 mm magnet pocket can open in the rim at each corner without breaking through the thin walls. The lid simply rests on the rim; the magnets hold it shut.

contract.summary: 70x70x30 open box, 2 mm walls, rim on top at z = height/2; four Ø6x3 magnet pockets open upward in solid corner posts at the rim; the lid sits on the rim.

brief.goal: a hand-cranked winch: a printed 120x80x6mm base with two 60mm-tall, 6mm-thick side plates; a crank shaft carrying a 15-tooth module-1.5 spur gear that drives a 45-tooth module-1.5 spur gear on a 30mm-diameter rope drum shaft (3:1 reduction); both shafts turn in 608 bearings in the side plates; a 60mm crank arm with a handle
brief.design: Sturdy utilitarian machine look: thick, honest walls, generous 1.5–2 mm fillets on outside edges and a softer fillet where bosses and the handle meet their parent surfaces. Round features stay crisp and concentric, nothing is decorated, and every part should read as one matched, workshop-grade set.

frame.title: Winch frame
frame.spec: One printed frame: a 120x80x6 base plate with two upright 60mm-tall, 6mm-thick side plates on its two short ends (x = ±60). Each plate has round bearing bosses on its inner face at the drum axis and the crank axis, so plate plus boss can hold two 608 bearings and a shoulder. Both axes run along x at the same height, 45mm apart along y, so the 15T and 45T gears mesh.

contract.name: Winch frame
contract.summary: Base 120x80x6 (z 0..6) with side plates rising 60mm above it at x = ±57. Shaft axes run along x at z = axisHeight: the drum at y = drumY, the crank at y = drumY + centerDistance. The drum seats face inward on the bosses. crank_seat_l is the left plate's outer face, where the crank arm sits. crank_seat_r is the right inner boss face, where the pinion sits. drum_seat_r is the right inner boss face, where the 45T gear sits.

drum.title: Rope drum
drum.spec: Printed rope drum with a 30mm-diameter core and a retaining flange at each end. It is pressed onto the drum shaft, which runs through its centre along local z. The left end face runs against the left bearing boss. The drum is short enough to leave a clear gap before the 45T gear, which sits against the right boss.

crank-arm.title: Crank arm
crank-arm.spec: Printed crank: a round hub pressed onto the crank shaft, plus a straight arm. The handle sits 60mm from the hub axis. The hub's underside (z = 0) runs against the left side plate. The arm lies across the top of the hub, and a round grip handle stands up from the arm's outer end, pointing away from the frame.
